en.title: Veronica Wipes the Face of Jesus
en.meditation:
Consider how the holy woman named Veronica, seeing Jesus so afflicted, and His face bathed in sweat and blood, presented Him with a towel, with which He wiped His adorable face, leaving on it the impression of His holy countenance.

My most beloved Jesus, Thy face was beautiful before, but in this journey it has lost all its beauty, and wounds and blood have disfigured it. Alas, my soul also was once beautiful, when it received Thy grace in Baptism; but I have disfigured it since by my sins; Thou alone, my Redeemer, canst restore it to its former beauty. Do this by Thy Passion, O Jesus. I repent of having offended Thee. Never permit me to offend Thee again. Grant that I may love Thee always; and then do with me what Thou wilt.
en.versicle: We adore Thee, O Christ, and we bless Thee.
en.response: Because by Thy holy Cross, Thou hast redeemed the world.
en.source: eCatholic2000.com, "The Way of the Cross" by St. Alphonsus de Liguori, https://www.ecatholic2000.com/liguori/stations/cross.shtml, retrieved 2026-08-23

fr.title: Véronique essuie la Sainte Face de Jésus
fr.meditation:
Considérons comment une sainte femme, nommée Véronique, voyant Jésus excédé de douleur, le visage inondé de sueur et de sang, lui présente un linge sur lequel Notre-Seigneur, en s’essuyant, imprime l’image de ses traits sacrés.

Mon très aimé Jésus, pendant Votre passion, le sang qui coulait de Vos blessures avait altéré la beauté de Votre visage. Hélas ! mon âme aussi était belle à mon Baptême, malheureusement je l’ai enlaidie par mes péchés. Vous seul, mon divin Rédempteur, pouvez lui rendre sa beauté ; faites-le, je vous en conjure, par votre passion.
fr.versicle: Nous t’adorons, ô Christ, et nous te bénissons,
fr.response: parce que tu as racheté le monde par ta sainte Croix.
fr.source: spiritualite-chretienne.com, "Chemin de Croix avec les meditations de St Alphonse de Liguori" (site now defunct/repurposed; archived via Wayback Machine, e.g. https://web.archive.org/web/20200221112546/http://www.spiritualite-chretienne.com/croix/stat-c01.html), retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (meditation); Diocese de Saint-Etienne (diocese-saintetienne.fr), "Chemin de Croix", https://www.diocese-saintetienne.fr/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Chemin-de-croix.pdf, retrieved 2026-08-23 -- provisional pending AELF licence, per content/README.md (versicle/response)
